quickstart_gpt_4o_mini.note: examples/quickstart/quickstart_neo4j.py at v0.30.2 with only the Graphiti constructor changed to gpt-4o-mini; entities and edges extracted normally

adapter_vs_documented_usage: matches: 'actor: content' message episodes, one episode per message, strictly increasing reference times (session date plus message index in seconds), free-text source description

dev_slice_gpt_4o_mini.replay: from the call cache: 484 hits, 2 misses ($0.0003)

conclusion: The sparse store comes from Graphiti's entity extraction on short conversational messages (about one entity, usually the speaker, per message, with either model), not from the adapter. gpt-4o-mini additionally proposes edges to the other speaker, who is not in the episode's entity list, and Graphiti drops them; the shipped models do not propose them. Edges kept are similar (9 against 8 on the first 15 messages).
